hub.title: Connect your Milesight gateway
hub.description: Enter the MQTT topic your gateway publishes uplinks to (Milesight gateway: Network Server > Applications > Data Transmission > MQTT). New devices will then appear automatically under Discovered.

data_description.payload_encoding: How the gateway encodes the raw payload in the 'data' field (Base64 is the Milesight default).
data_description.downlink_topic: Used to switch WS wall switches and sockets. {deveui} is replaced by the device's DevEUI (Milesight gateway: set the downlink topic to e.g. milesight/downlink/$deveui).
data_description.downlink_format: Milesight gateway JSON (confirmed / fPort / data) or ChirpStack v4 (adds devEui).
data_description.extra_topics: Optional, comma separated, wildcards allowed. Point the gateway's ACK Notification, Join Notification and Gateway Information MQTT topics here (e.g. milesight/ack, milesight/join, milesight/gateway) – or ChirpStack gateway/+/event/stats, application/+/device/+/event/ack.
data_description.gateway_offline_min: A gateway is shown offline when it has forwarded nothing (and sent no status report) for this long.

data.name: Name
data.register_on_gateway: Also add it to the gateway

data_description.deveui: 16 hex characters, printed on the device label.
data_description.area: Room / area name – created if it doesn't exist.
data_description.register_on_gateway: Registers the DevEUI on the Milesight gateway's network server so the device can join – no need to open the gateway's web page.
data_description.app_key: 32 hex digits, filled in with the gateway's default AppKey (Milesight factory key unless changed). Change it if the device label shows its own key.
data_description.purpose: What the device is fitted to (fridge, gate, pump, bin …). Sets its label, how its entities look, default alarm limits and the dashboards it appears on. Can be changed later (Configure → Purpose).

site.title: Site information
site.description: Shown in the banner of the Building dashboard. Taken from Home Assistant: the name ("{ha_name}", Settings → System → General), country, time zone, the Home zone, areas (Settings → Areas) and the contact person (Settings → People). Fill in only what Home Assistant does not know.

data_description.site_company: Leave empty to use the Home Assistant name. The site name is this gateway's name (rename it on the integration page).
data_description.site_contact: A Home Assistant person – name and picture come from Settings → People.
data_description.site_address: Home Assistant only stores the map position, so enter the street address here.
data_description.site_logo: Image path or URL. Put the file in the www folder of your configuration and enter /local/<file name>.
data_description.site_areas: In this order. Leave empty to show every area that has Milesight devices.
data_description.site_outside_sensor: Shown as a badge at the top of the dashboard.
data_description.co2_alert: Areas above this level appear in Needs attention and the banner.
data_description.update_dashboard: Generates the dashboard with a section per area. Also available as the gateway's 'Update building dashboard' button.

data.empty_grace_min: Count as empty after (minutes at 0 people)
data.auto_backfill: Fetch stored data after an outage

data_description.max_gap_min: Time is not counted across gaps longer than this, so an offline sensor doesn't add phantom open/occupied time. Set it above the device's reporting interval.
data_description.model: Change this if the wrong model was picked. Entities from the old model can then be deleted from the device page.
data_description.co2_limit: Time above this level is counted as 'CO2 above limit'. 1000 ppm is a common indoor guideline.
data_description.install_height_mm: Distance the sensor measures when the bin / tank is empty (sensor to bottom). Used to calculate the fill level %. 0 = off.
data_description.run_threshold_a: The load counts as running while the current (any channel) is at or above this. Used for running time and start counts.
data_description.mains_voltage: Phase voltage, e.g. 230. Enables the 'Estimated power' sensors (current × voltage, apparent power in VA). 0 = off.
data_description.battery_low_pct: The 'Battery low' sensor turns on below this level.
data_description.meter_type: Turn the pulse counter into a water / gas / electricity meter for the Energy dashboard.
data_description.meter_pulses_per_unit: e.g. 1 pulse per litre with unit L = 1; 100 pulses per m³ = 100.
data_description.meter_offset: Reading of the physical meter when counting started, so Home Assistant shows the same number.
data_description.meter_source: Leave empty (pulse_count / gpio_counter_1). For a second UC counter enter e.g. gpio_counter_2.
data_description.auto_backfill: When the device comes back after a gap, ask it to resend what it stored and fill the history graphs.
data_description.confirmed_downlinks: Ask the device to acknowledge every downlink (LoRaWAN confirmed). Needs the gateway's ACK notification topic under the gateway's settings. Uses a little more airtime.
data_description.downlink_retries: Commands the device does not answer within two uplinks are sent again this many times, then marked failed. 0 = never retry.
data_description.display_max_bytes: Text blocks are packed into downlinks of at most this size. 51 works at every EU868 data rate; raise it (up to 222) for displays close to a gateway, lower it to 11 for US915 SF10.

channels.title: Channels (Modbus / analog)
channels.description:
Give the controller's channels a name, unit and scale so third-party probes become proper sensors. One line per channel:

`channel; name; unit; scale; offset; device class; decimals; state class; options`

`3; Tank pressure; bar; 0.01`
`3.2; Flow; m³/h; 0.1; 0; volume_flow_rate; 1`
`adc_1; Borehole level; m; 4-20>0-10`

Channel: the Modbus channel number set in Milesight ToolBox (3 = channel 3, 3.2 = channel 3 register 2) or the input (adc_1, adv_1, analog_input_1, pt100_1, gpio_counter_1). Scale: a multiplier, or a range 4-20>0-10 that maps the raw span onto the real one. Options: `s16` for signed registers, `invalid=65535` for the value a probe sends when it has no reading. Leave columns empty (or -) for the default. Ready-made lines for common probes: Configure → *Apply a sensor template*.

Reported so far: {seen}{problems}

tank.title: Tank or silo
tank.description:
Turns the level reading into litres, fill %, usage per day and days until empty, and spots refills and sudden drops (theft or a leak). Capacity with these settings: **{capacity}**.

Upright cylinder: diameter + height. Lying cylinder: diameter + length. Rectangular: length + width + height. Silo with a cone: diameter + total height + cone height. Any other shape: capacity + height (litres follow the level).

data.tank_drop_pct: Sudden-drop alarm when it falls by

data_description.install_height_mm: What the sensor measures when the tank is empty (sensor to floor).
data_description.tank_height_mm: Liquid level when the tank is full. Leave 0 to use the empty distance (sensor at the top of a full tank). A lying cylinder uses its diameter.
data_description.tank_capacity_l: Leave 0 to calculate it from the size. Set it for 'Any other shape', or to match the tank's label.
data_description.tank_density: kg/m³, e.g. diesel 840, water 1000, feed pellets 650. Adds a 'Contents weight' sensor. 0 = off.
data_description.tank_low_pct: The 'Tank low' sensor turns on below this fill. 0 = off.
data_description.tank_refill_pct: A rise of at least this share of the capacity counts as a refill (event milesight_lorawan_tank).
data_description.tank_drop_pct: Diesel / theft protection: a fall of at least this share of the capacity within the time below turns on 'Sudden drop'. 0 = off.

alerts.title: Alert escalation
alerts.description: Sends alerts to phones (Home Assistant Companion app) with an Acknowledge button. Nobody acknowledges within the escalation time → the backup people are notified too. Non-critical alerts wait until quiet hours end; leaks, smoke, gas, falls, sudden tank drops and gateway outages always go through.

data.alert_dedupe_min: Treat a re-trigger within (minutes) as the same alert
data.alert_notify_resolved: Tell people when it is resolved
data.alert_action_entity: Extra button on tank-low alerts runs

data_description.alert_primary: notify services, e.g. notify.mobile_app_juans_phone. Leave empty to switch escalation off.
data_description.alert_quiet_start: e.g. 22 to 6. Leave both empty for none.
data_description.alert_dedupe_min: Stops a flapping sensor from sending the same alert again and again.
data_description.alert_action_entity: Optional: a switch, script or button, e.g. the borehole pump. Pressing it on the phone also acknowledges the alert.

provisioning.title: Add devices to the gateway
provisioning.description: Lets Home Assistant register new devices on the Milesight gateway (DevEUI + AppKey), so you do not have to open the gateway's web page. On the gateway: Network Server → Applications → your application → Data Transmission → MQTT: set **Request Data Topic** and **Response Data Topic** to the topics below (they must be different). Leave the request topic empty to switch this off.

data_description.ns_gateway_eui: Only needed when several gateways share the broker.
data_description.ns_app_key: Used when a device is added without its own key. Milesight devices ship with 5572404c696e6b4c6f52613230313823.

provisioning_target.title: Application and profile
provisioning_target.description: The gateway answered: {devices} devices, {apps} applications, {profiles} profiles. New devices are added to this application with this device profile (ClassA-OTAA suits battery sensors; pick a Class C profile for mains-powered switches and valves added later by hand).

pump.title: Pump analytics
pump.description: For a current clamp on a pump or motor: run hours, starts per hour (short-cycling), dry-run when the current falls well below normal (lost prime, empty well) and overload when it rises well above (blockage, bearing, low voltage). With a water meter you also get m³ pumped today and m³ per kWh.

data_description.pump_normal_a: Leave 0 to learn it: the median running current of the last 7 days (about a day of running is needed).
data_description.pump_power_factor: Only used when the clamp has no energy counter: energy = current × mains voltage (Device settings) × power factor.
data_description.pump_water_entity: A water meter sensor for the water this pump delivers, e.g. a pulse counter set up as a water meter.

pivot.title: Centre pivot
pivot.description:
For an AT101 on the end tower of a centre pivot: arm angle, % of the round done, speed, time to finish and a stall alarm when the position stops changing during a round. Last fix from the tracker: **{last_fix}**.

Tip: set the tracker's reporting interval to 5–10 minutes while the pivot runs.

data.pivot_enabled: This tracker is on a pivot

data_description.pivot_centre: Drag the marker to the pivot point (the tower in the middle).
data_description.pivot_sector: 360 for a full circle; less for a part-circle pivot that reverses at the ends.
data_description.pivot_stall_min: Minutes without movement during a round before the stall alarm. Press 'Pivot stopped (end round)' when you stop it on purpose.

irrigation.title: Irrigation and frost
irrigation.description: Uses a weather forecast and soil moisture sensors: skip irrigation when rain is forecast or the soil is moist enough, otherwise suggest how long to irrigate; warn of frost from the afternoon before. Creates 'Irrigation advice', 'Rain expected' and 'Frost tonight' on the gateway. Use the advice in the 'Milesight – valve schedule' blueprint.

data.irr_rain_mm: Skip when rain of at least
data.irr_rain_prob: … with a probability of at least

data_description.irr_weather: Any weather entity with a forecast (Met.no, OpenWeatherMap, Open-Meteo …). Hourly forecasts work best.
data_description.irr_soil: Their average is used (e.g. EM500-SMTC, WTS506 soil moisture).
data_description.irr_base_minutes: The time is scaled by how far the soil is below the target and reduced when some rain is expected.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description:
What is this {model} fitted to? The purpose sets the device's label (Milesight · Cold chain, · Security …), how its entities look (a contact as a window or gate, a fridge icon), default alarm limits, extra analytics (duty cycle, cold-chain log, bin fill …) and which dashboards it appears on.

The same purpose fits every sensor on one thing: the fridge's temperature probe, its door contact and the clamp on its compressor are all *Fridge / cold room*.

data_description.purpose_1: 3-channel clamps: give a channel its own purpose when the channels measure different loads (leave 'not set' for a single 3-phase motor).

purpose_settings.title: Alarm limits – {purpose}
purpose_settings.description: Defaults for this purpose; change them to match the unit. Leave a field empty to use the default.

data.p_temp_rise_day: Hot-spot alarm when it rises by (per 24 h)
data.p_after_hours: Alert on activity outside working hours
data.p_bin_depth_mm: Distance when the bin is empty
data.p_empty_distance_mm: Distance at the lowest water level

data_description.p_temp_delay_min: Door openings and defrost cycles push the temperature out of range for a short while; only longer excursions raise the alarm (they are all counted in 'Time out of range today').
data_description.p_max_run_h: 0 = off. A fridge compressor that never stops cannot keep up (door, seals, gas, condenser).
data_description.p_no_run_h: 0 = off. A compressor that should cycle but has not run for this long has tripped or failed.
data_description.p_service_h: 0 = off. Press '… serviced' after the service to start counting again.

channel_template.title: Sensor templates

channel_template_values.title: {template}
channel_template_values.description:
Choose the values to read, the first Modbus channel to use (they take consecutive channels) and the probe's RS485 address.

{notes}{problems}

data_description.first_channel: Suggested: the first channel not used in the channel map yet. The UC300 / UC50x have 16 Modbus channels.
data_description.prefix: E.g. 'Field 3' → 'Field 3 Soil moisture' – useful with two probes of the same kind.

force.description: Also send blocks that already show this text (normally skipped to save battery and airtime).

acknowledge_alert.name: Acknowledge alert
acknowledge_alert.description: Stops escalation and reminders for an alert (all open alerts when no ID is given).

alert_id.name: Alert ID
alert_id.description: From the Open alerts sensor; leave empty for all.

add_to_gateway.name: Add device to gateway
add_to_gateway.description: Registers a DevEUI on the Milesight gateway's network server (needs 'Add devices to the gateway' in the gateway's options).

app_key.name: AppKey
app_key.description: 32 hex digits; empty = the gateway setting.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Optional device profile (from the 'Devices on gateway' sensor's attributes).

remove_from_gateway.name: Remove device from gateway
remove_from_gateway.description: Deletes a DevEUI from the gateway's network server.

sync_gateway_devices.name: Sync devices with gateway
sync_gateway_devices.description: Reads the gateway's device list; devices Home Assistant does not have yet are offered under Discovered.

tank_refilled.name: Tank refilled
tank_refilled.description: Records a refill now and clears a sudden-drop alarm.

device_id.name: Tank sensor
device_id.description: One or more level sensors with a tank set up.
